rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for leaving an asset to someone in a will or inheritance context.

example.english: I will bequeath the house to my son.
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 lau4 bei2 go3 zai2

rows.note: Use this precise legal term in formal discussions or written documents about leaving property by will.

example.english: The will states: I bequeath this painting to the museum.
example.traditional: 遺囑寫明：本人遺贈呢幅畫畀博物館。
example.jyutping: wai4 zuk1 se2 ming4 bun2 jan4 wai6 zang6 ne1 fuk1 waak6 bei2 bok3 mat6 gun2

rows.note: Use this for passing knowledge, customs, skills, or possessions on to another person or generation.

example.english: We should bequeath this craft to the next generation.
example.traditional: 我哋要將呢門手藝傳畀下一代。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 ne1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 cyun4 bei2 haa6 jat1 doi6
